before.value: Bow: creates a shimmering, multilayered bow with seven rainbow missiles, each equal to a +3 weapon; the bow disappears after firing all seven. Each hue deals double damage to its listed targets: red—fire-dwellers/users; orange—earth elementals; yellow—vegetable targets, including fungus creatures, shambling mounds, and treants; green—aquatic creatures and water elementals; blue—aerial creatures, electricity-using creatures, and air elementals; indigo—acid- or poison-using creatures; violet—metallic or regenerating creatures. If no hue is requested, or a previously used hue is requested, the next arrow in spectrum order appears.
